_comment: Provenance pin for the plant in this directory. scripts/check_model_identity.py refuses to train when the XML hash or any number below disagrees with the compiled training model. Written 2026-09-10 when the MOD4 chassis delivery replaced the 0910 RM2025 file. Everything under incoming/rm2025_fixed is DEPRECATED (0908/0910) and must never be selected again.
source_cad: 底盘_MOD4.STEP (277 CAD parts kept as visuals)

superseded.status: DEPRECATED - renamed on 2026-09-10 so nothing can pick it up by default

solver.note: 0910 used iterations=80; MOD4 ships 100. The identity gate reads this from the compiled model, so the training plant must keep 100.

topology.note: same closed-chain topology as 0908/0910 (6 connect + 4 joint-coupling), equality rank 16, independent velocity DOF 12

wheel.status: MDCF ctrlrange/forcerange carry +-5.77590977444; envelope still an estimate, rotor inertia unmeasured

gas_spring.status: 700 N candidate per side, NOT verified against the MOD4 hardware; fast-compression/temperature/friction uncalibrated

masses_kg.status: CAD volume x assumed densities and motor mass estimates - not a weighing result

geometry.leg_symmetry: 55 hinge-anchor pair distances identical left vs right (measured 2026-09-10)

joint_conventions_that_changed_vs_0910.note: MOD4 re-zeroed the model at a closed, collision-free middle posture. Every policy trained on 0908/0910 must be retrained: the same action vector means a different joint target.
